sum: Packs an entire repository into one file shaped for a model.

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 4 of the 5 neutral interface standards (MCP, AGENTS.md, Agent Plugins, Agent Skills)
evidence.se.threats: cites th: no OWASP Agentic AI threat is introduced by adopting this entry, so there is nothing here to control against
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format packed-text: one packed text file: readable, but the packing is the tool's own
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec, ctrl and data_residency: the entry does not execute code itself and keeps its state local, so there is no unattended reach for a control to bound
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: Cline, Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI (README.md)
evidence.ic.help: a command-line parser that prints its own usage: package.json (commander)
evidence.ic.error: a documented flag that gates or previews the action: README.md (confirmation prompt)
evidence.fx.install: an install that does not change the machine globally: README.md (npx r)
evidence.fx.byo: the entry does not call a model provider itself, so there is no provider for the operator to substitute
evidence.sf.stop: stopping is described in prose only: README.md (Ctrl+C)
evidence.sf.warn: the irreversible step is both warned about and gated: README.md (> [!WARNING])
evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: local-first, the operator's state stays on their machine

gnote: Watch for secrets. Exclusion settings are the defensive line
